hero_tagline: are getting married in the hills of Umbria
hero_location: 20 August 2027 · Tenuta di Forte Sorgnano · Umbria
welcome_text: We're gathering the people we love most for three golden days in the heart of *Umbria* — a thousand-year-old castle, long Italian dinners, sunshine by the pool, and one very big *"I do."*
welcome_subtext: We can't wait to celebrate with you.
strip_text: Drinks, limoncello & dancing under the Umbrian stars — join us for the full weekend

landscape.heading: The Hills of Umbria
landscape.text: Cypress trees, olive groves, medieval hilltops and a slower pace of life. August in Umbria is golden in every sense of the word.

banner.heading: Limoncello o'clock somewhere in Umbria
banner.text: Cold glasses, warm evenings and the sound of cicadas. The estate's terrace was made for this.
